title: UE Blueprint Diagnose
description: Diagnose one Blueprint with bounded static, structural, compile, and optional runtime evidence.

recipes.title: Scan and verify one Blueprint
recipes.description: Read one Blueprint, run a bounded scan, inspect structural evidence, and compile-validate the asset.

inputs.name: graph
inputs.description: Graph name selected from a finding location.

inputs.name: runtimeRunId
inputs.description: Retained Kismet trace run used only for optional correlation.

steps.purpose: Read stable Blueprint identity, graphs, variables, and structural summary before analysis.
Produce bounded findings for the explicitly selected asset or /Game prefix.
Inspect the strongest finding at its exact graph location before following cross-asset calls and references.
Compile-validate the inspected asset without saving it.
Correlate retained findings with an existing runtime trace without starting a debug workflow.

result.summary: Evidence-backed Blueprint diagnosis with explicit confidence and runtime status.
evidence: findingId, ruleId, severity, confidence, and node location
success: the scan was explicitly scoped to one asset or /Game prefix
high-value findings were inspected at their exact graph locations
Tick reachability was claimed only after tracing execution pins from Event Tick to the candidate node or observing matching runtime evidence
unmeasured runtime reachability was not presented as fact

resources.description: Detailed operation order, parameter boundaries, and evidence interpretation.
